slides.title: Introduction to CSS
slides.notes:
Strong foundations are important
If you become strong here, in the next stages you will understand things at just one glance. To get that speed, you have to spend time here. It is more important to understand things systematically. 

Many people rush here and complicate things in the later stages. But, we will develop you in such a way that as we go ahead, you will become more powerful.
